description: This file contains PHP functions related to PHP-XMLRPC integration, including type conversions, function wrappers, method wrappers for XMLRPC calls, class generation to wrap remote XMLRPC server methods, and helper functions for dynamic code generation. It primarily facilitates exposing PHP functions as XMLRPC methods and wrapping XMLRPC server methods as PHP functions or classes.

methods.name: php_2_xmlrpc_type
methods.description: Converts a PHP type string to a corresponding XMLRPC type string based on global type definitions, handling common PHP types and class-based types.

methods.name: xmlrpc_2_php_type
methods.description: Converts an XMLRPC type string to the corresponding PHP type string, supporting standard XMLRPC types and returning 'mixed' for 'undefined'.

methods.name: wrap_php_function
methods.description: Generates a PHP wrapper function that exposes a user-defined PHP function as an XMLRPC method, including parsing of Javadoc comments for type and documentation inference, and dynamic code generation.

methods.name: wrap_xmlrpc_method
methods.description: Creates a PHP function that calls a remote XMLRPC method via a provided client, with options for signature selection, error handling, and code source generation for debugging or further use.

methods.name: wrap_xmlrpc_server
methods.description: Generates a PHP class that wraps all methods exposed by a remote XMLRPC server as class methods; it creates code dynamically based on server method list and supports options for code inspection.

methods.name: build_remote_method_wrapper_code
methods.description: Builds PHP code that defines a function to invoke a specified remote XMLRPC method, handling parameter encoding, request sending, and response decoding, with options for fault response handling.

methods.name: build_client_wrapper_code
methods.description: Generates PHP code to instantiate and initialize a PHP-XMLRPC client object, copying configuration fields from an existing client, used internally for code generation.
